findings.note: A malformed inventory with origin as an array or object raises TypeError during membership testing against the set; main catches only InventoryError, so the standalone verifier emits an uncaught traceback instead of the contract-required invalid-inventory exit 2. Type-check origin before set membership, convert malformed values to InventoryError, and add subprocess cases asserting ERROR/exit 2.

findings.section: _load_inventory shape validation (lines 89-156); CLI contract §3 line 78; schema additionalProperties (schema lines 7, 16, 47, 73)
findings.note: The verifier claims schema-equivalent validation but does not reject unknown properties at the document, snapshot, source_reference, or file-entry levels. The published schema sets additionalProperties:false at each of these objects, and the CLI contract requires schema validation. Enforce the allowed key sets (or validate against the schema without adding a receiving-side dependency) and test that an inventory with an extra field is rejected with exit 2.
